상충 근거 비교·채택·보류"]
    needSearch{"추가 근거 필요?"}
    targetedSearch["쟁점별 반대근거 검색"]

    alternatives["증액·유지·감액 비교"]
    allocation["배분안·자금 이동 계산"]
    review{"근거·전제·제약 점검"}
    finalChoice["배분·유지 확정 및 사유 기록"]

    fundContext --> retrieve
    retrieve --> evidence
    criteria -.-> evidence
    evidence --> needSearch
    needSearch -->|"필요"| targetedSearch
    targetedSearch -->|"추가 근거 반영"| evidence
    needSearch -->|"현재 근거로 평가"| evaluate
    evaluate --> alternatives
    alternatives --> allocation
    allocation --> review
    review -->|"근거 갱신·해석 변경"| evidence
    review -->|"제약 위반"| alternatives
    review -->|"근거 부합·제약 충족"| finalChoice

    style criteria fill:#F1F3F5,stroke:#868E96
    style evidence fill:#C2E5FF,stroke:#3DADFF
    style targetedSearch fill:#FFE0C2,stroke:#FF9E42
    style review fill:#DCCCFF,stroke:#874FFF
    style finalChoice fill:#CDF4D3,stroke:#66D575

    linkStyle 4,5 stroke:#C26820,stroke-width:2.5px
    linkStyle 10 stroke:#6F42A8,stroke-width:3px
